implementationRules: Remove issued96m interim shares annually before counting2018 options;June forfeiture is already reflected in reported common.
Remove423.743904m conditional issued shares from plain common and model once as call-like claim with334.09 offset.
June2018 options are zero;286.428773m net replacement restricted shares are already in reported common.Assume continued service,no second deduction,no hypothetical cash exercise proceeds.
Do not subtract annual138380m market-based aggregate option intrinsic value from DCF equity.It uses a different underlying valuation and double counts if combined with diluted awards.
Use actual common shares,not weighted-average dilutedEPS shares.

Ordinary employee options use conservative free-share proxy to avoid pretending aggregate average strike prices are each individual strike.All annualperformanceawards13m are not added separately to annualtotaloption/RSUtable;that would overlap.
Keep GAAP compensation in business EBIT;claims overlay values existing awards.Future compensation expense/awards are not removed or separately added.
Use baseline dates for remainingterm;data known through cutoff may clarify history but future cash or financing must not be silently mixed in.

notes.en: Musk’s old options and 96 million interim shares are reconciled once; June exercise is already inside common shares. The 423.7 million performance award has a $334.09 per-share offset and is modeled as a full-vesting vanilla-call proxy instead of free common stock. This conservative proxy includes time value but ignores milestone and service restrictions. Employee awards use a small, explicitly estimated dilution buffer; June is not a reported award inventory.
notes.zh-Hans: 马斯克旧期权与9600万股临时奖励只计算一次；6月已行权股份已包含在普通股中。4.237亿股绩效奖励每股需抵扣334.09美元，采用假设全部归属的普通看涨期权代理估值，而非当作免费普通股。该保守代理计入时间价值，但未折减业绩门槛及服务限制。员工奖励使用明确标注的稀释估计，6月数量并非披露的期末余额。
